main_text.p: תה שער לספר על אי fuerit maledictio hæc? & fuit abeodie & ultra, defecit Hyrcanus à verbis Pharisæorum, & roboratus est cum Saducæis, fuitque Saducæus.
16. Præcepitque rex & promulgarunt per castra & per totam terram Israel dicendo, Omnis doctor, qui docet filios suos de lege Pharisæorum, moriendo morictur.
17. Et occidit Hyrcanus è Pharisæis in die illo multos, & etiam Eleazarum, qui maledixerat gloriæ ipsius, combussit igne, & etiam ex tenui plebecula, quorum manus erat cum Pharisæis, occidit multos.
18. Propterea excitatum est odium in eum & in filios ejus, quo profecuti sunt eum Israelitæ & semen ejus à diebus illis.
19. Et dixit Ioseph filius Gorion, nunc aperiam tibi portam

page.notes: The right-hand part of each Hebrew line is missing from the scan, so the words are only partly legible. Hebrew letters are read from the left fragments and may be wrong; several readings are uncertain and are not marked with [?] because the fragments are short. The Latin running head is only partly visible. Hebrew letters in the left margin are not transcribed. Catchword "portam" is at the foot right; the scan is cut at the top of the page; the watermark "Digitized by Google" is ignored.
